name: search_docs
description: Search neon.com: docs, API reference, PostgreSQL tutorial, guides, FAQs, changelog, and blog. Returns ranked pages with title, URL, the matching section, and a slug; read a full page with get_doc.

categories.description: Only return pages in these categories: docs, api (API reference), postgresql (PostgreSQL tutorial), guides, faqs, blog, changelog. Omit to search everything.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (1-40).

query.description: What to search for, in words, e.g. "reset a branch" or "connection pooling".
